L'Oréal Glycolic Bright Face Wash

The glycolic bright face wash from L'Oréal Paris turns your daily cleanse into a glow step. Its creamy foam washes away dirt, oil and sweat, while glycolic acid gently exfoliates dull surface cells so your skin looks smoother, fresher and more even.

{{image:2}}

Pakistan's heat, dust and pollution can leave skin tired and uneven. This glycolic acid face wash is gentle enough for morning and night, and effective enough to make a visible difference to dullness with regular use.

Why You'll Love This Glycolic Bright Face Wash

Glycolic Acid Power
Glycolic acid is a well-known AHA that helps loosen dead skin cells for a brighter-looking complexion.

Removes Dullness
Regular use helps skin look clearer, smoother and more radiant, which makes it a true face wash for glowing skin.

Even, Glowing Skin
Made to support a more even-looking skin tone as part of your daily routine.

Creamy, Rich Foam
A small amount goes a long way. The foam spreads easily and rinses off without a heavy feel.

Trusted Loreal Face Wash
Dermatologically tested and made by L'Oréal Paris, one of the world's most trusted beauty brands.

How to Use the Glycolic Bright Face Wash

  1. Wet your face with lukewarm water.
  2. Squeeze a small amount onto your palms and work it into a foam.
  3. Massage gently over your face in circular motions, avoiding the eye area.
  4. Rinse thoroughly and pat dry.
  5. Follow with a moisturiser, and use sunscreen during the day.
